body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Motorola presented a docking station that is attached to a bike. The docking station can charge a handset while users ride on the bike.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Nikki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Seo >
